Hill of Fist and Fang

Connects to: 13.24, 16.16, 16.16.05, 18.19, 18.28, 23.11.03 and the Devil’s Fingers.

This shrub-covered hill nominally marks the Duchy’s extreme southern frontier. It is the site of an ancient and spectacular ritual that proves the greatest Thringish knights’ courage and mettle, where The Brothers of the Lion earn their lion mounts.
